rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound object of knowing; internal members gūḍha + sadbhāva
state that comes into being as result
main verb indicating emergence of the resulting state

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: There is a hidden true nature that can be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature produces a transformative result.
All-knowingness is the state that emerges from such knowing.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
